items.name: KAV-MAN
items.flavor: The city knew the name before the algorithm did.

moves.name: Soundcheck
moves.desc: The room goes quiet first. Reveal the crowd.

moves.name: Hometown Anthem
moves.desc: Discard 2 Energies. Every seat in the building takes it.

items.lore:
San Antonio rapper. First artist on the roster. Not a subject, a member: the desk shoots every frame of what comes next.

What he's loading stays off the page until it drops. When it drops, it drops with our footage on it.

Texas first. Then everywhere else.

items.name: VIRGOSGATEWAY
items.flavor: You've already heard him. You just didn't know it.

moves.name: Alignment
moves.desc: Universal divinity receives it. Next move does +60.

moves.name: Final Bounce
moves.desc: Prints the master. Everything in the mix hits at once.

items.lore:
Producer and engineer. Credits scattered across records you already play. Check the fine print.

Second artist on the roster. Sessions are closed, and what's coming out of them is classified until it isn't.

When the file opens, the desk has the frames.

items.name: The Ink
items.flavor: Oil on canvas after hours. Skin by appointment.

moves.name: Line Work
moves.desc: Slow is smooth. Next move can't miss.

moves.name: Black & Grey
moves.desc: No color needed. The shading does the talking.

items.lore:
Black and grey by appointment, oil on canvas after hours. The crossover is the story.

Interview 002 is in production: the format moves from the chair to the bench. The machine runs while the conversation does, and the room light stays the room light.

The subject sees the cut before anyone else. House rule. The reveal is the drop.

items.name: The Page
items.flavor: Draws the rooms the cameras can't enter.

moves.name: Cold Open
moves.desc: Sets the scene in one panel.

moves.name: Splash Page
moves.desc: Full bleed. No dialogue needed.

items.lore:
Comics, zines, ink on paper. The lane where the scene draws itself.

Seat 003 is in talks. The reveal is the drop.

Same house rules apply: the subject sees the cut first, and off the record stays off the record.

items.name: The Hairstylist
items.flavor: Does the color on camera. Conversation cuts deeper.

moves.name: Dye Job
moves.desc: Marks the next subject in the scene.

moves.name: First Cut
moves.desc: Sets the format. Coin flip: heads, copy the format.

items.lore:
The chair is the studio. Pastel pink, electric blue, leopard streaks — whatever the subject brings in. The cut starts the conversation; the dye finishes it.

She's the format we keep returning to: each interview shot at the subject's own station, the work happening on-camera while they talk. The chair is a confession booth with better lighting.

Seat 001. The one that set the rule.

items.name: The Promoter
items.flavor: Holds the door. Knows who pays the rider.

moves.name: Flyer Drop
moves.desc: Posts a venue. Reveals one secret show.

moves.name: Doors at 9
moves.desc: Loads the queue. Crowd silences any Take this turn.

items.lore:
Holds the door. Knows who pays the rider. Books the room before the artist knows they're playing it.

The load-bearing wall of the underground — the one keeping shows on the books while everyone else argues about the bill. Local SA venues run on her flyer drops. The crowd never sees her, but the show wouldn't exist without her.

Final word on who gets in, who gets the green room, who comes back next month.

items.name: The DJ
items.flavor: Knows what the room needs before it does.

moves.name: Crossfade
moves.desc: Switch any lane mid-set.

moves.name: Drop the Beat
moves.desc: Discard one Take to do +30 to a Voice.

items.lore:
Reads the floor in two bars and adjusts. Underground hours: 1AM start, 4AM peak, 6AM closer.

The format authority. Every set is an essay on the scene's temperature — Carti deep cuts into Sematary edits into a Snow Strippers slow-burn. No requests. No talking on the mic.

The crossfade is the only commentary that matters.

items.name: The Label Head

moves.name: A&R Stare
moves.desc: Marks a Pitch. Returns it next turn.

moves.name: Test Pressing
moves.desc: Discard two Energies. Hits anything in the public feed.

items.lore:
Final cut. Final cheque. The one who says yes or no on a test pressing.

Runs a small underground roster out of a bedroom studio. Picks the artists, signs the bills, kills projects that aren't ready. Reputation built on saying no more than yes.

The A&R stare is the toll. If you survive it, the cheque clears.

items.name: The Provocateur
items.flavor: Off the record stays off the record. The rest is fair game.

moves.name: Subtweet
moves.desc: Reveal one Pitch from your deck. Your opponent cannot respond this turn.

moves.name: Drag
moves.desc: Choose 1 Voice in play. They cannot use their attack until two turns pass.

items.lore:
Speaks for nobody. Speaks for everybody. Starting fights in the group chat at 3AM.

The scene's loose cannon — anonymous account, sharp takes, ten followers in the know. Drags artists who should be dragged. Defends artists who shouldn't be. Everyone reads the subtweets even if they pretend not to.

Off the record stays off the record. Everything else is fair game.

items.name: The Painter
items.flavor: Says it all without saying it.

moves.name: Underpainting
moves.desc: Sets up the next attack. Next move does +50.

moves.name: One Stroke
moves.desc: One canvas, one shot. Discard if you flip tails.

items.lore:
Says it all without saying it. The one whose Instagram is just photos of their wall.

Works in oil and gesso. Paints scene portraits that hang in apartments and venue green rooms. Documents the people the cameras don't catch. One canvas a month, sometimes less.

Pretty-first, with teeth — but the teeth are subtle. You see them after the second look.

items.name: The Archivist
items.flavor: Remembers. Even the things you deleted.

moves.name: Footnote
moves.desc: Reveals what's in the file.

moves.name: Receipt
moves.desc: Brings back any old Take from your discard pile.

items.lore:
Remembers. Even the things you deleted. Even the things you wish you hadn't said.

Runs a Dropbox of flyers, screenshots, deleted IG stories, secret-show photos. Hard drive of receipts going back six years. The scene's institutional memory before the scene is old enough to have one.

When the Provocateur drags someone, the Archivist provides the source material.

items.name: The Outsider
items.flavor: Watches from the door. Knows the room better than the regulars.

moves.name: Lurk
moves.desc: Sees the room first. Look at the top 3 cards.

moves.name: Through The Door
moves.desc: Always returns to the scene.

items.lore:
Watches from the door. Knows the room better than the regulars.

Not in any clique. Shows up to every show, doesn't drink, doesn't post, doesn't network. Just clocks the room and leaves.

Eventually becomes the most reliable narrator the scene has — because they're the only one with no skin in the game.
